themes_detail.label: NYPD Enforcement Surge
themes_detail.summary: Real Time Enforcement complaints spiked to 16 THIS WEEK, a 2,460% increase versus 0.6 weekly average over the prior 8 weeks (z-score: 15.5), suggesting a sudden policy shift or enforcement operation in Fort Greene/Brooklyn Heights that residents are documenting through 311.
evidence: 16 Real Time Enforcement complaints THIS WEEK vs 0.6 weekly baseline (8-week average)
Z-score of 15.5 indicates statistically extreme deviation
No prior week exceeded 3 complaints in this category over trailing 8 weeks
reporting_angles: Contact NYPD about new enforcement initiatives or detail deployment in CD 302
Interview residents about what type of enforcement they're reporting and perceived impact on neighborhood

themes_detail.label: IAD Complaints Spike
themes_detail.summary: Investigations and Discipline complaints jumped to 6 THIS WEEK, a 2,300% spike from 0.2 weekly average (z-score: 13.28), indicating residents are escalating concerns about police conduct or departmental accountability directly to 311.
evidence: 6 IAD complaints THIS WEEK vs 0.2 weekly baseline (8-week average)
Z-score of 13.28 represents extreme statistical outlier
Coincides with Real Time Enforcement spike, suggesting related incident or policy change
reporting_angles: FOIL recent IAD complaints filed from CD 302 to determine nature of conduct allegations
Interview community members and activists about what triggered the surge in complaints
Determine if Real Time Enforcement spike and IAD spike are linked to same incident or policy

themes_detail.label: Electrical System Failures
themes_detail.summary: Electrical complaints surged to 6 THIS WEEK, a 700% increase from 0.8 weekly average (z-score: 5.42), signaling possible infrastructure problems or widespread outages affecting Fort Greene/Brooklyn Heights residents.
evidence: 6 Electrical complaints THIS WEEK vs 0.8 weekly baseline (8-week average)
Z-score of 5.42 indicates significant statistical anomaly
Concentrated timing suggests localized or widespread infrastructure event rather than chronic issue
reporting_angles: Contact Con Edison for outage reports, maintenance work, or system issues in CD 302 this week
Canvass affected residential buildings to document power loss duration and impact
Check if spike correlates with weather events or planned utility work

themes_detail.label: For-Hire Vehicle Complaints Surge
themes_detail.summary: For-Hire Vehicle complaints jumped to 40 last week, a 183% increase from 14.1 weekly average (z-score: 6.6), indicating growing resident friction with Uber, Lyft, or other app-based car services in the neighborhood.
evidence: 40 For-Hire Vehicle complaints LAST WEEK vs 14.1 weekly baseline (8-week average)
Z-score of 6.6 represents significant statistical spike
Likely driven by congestion, illegal parking, or unsafe driving behavior complaints
reporting_angles: Analyze specific complaint types within the For-Hire Vehicle category (illegal parking, traffic, pickups/dropoffs)
Interview residents about congestion or safety issues caused by app-based cars
Contact TLC about enforcement activity and complaints in Fort Greene/Brooklyn Heights

themes_detail.label: Street Light Infrastructure Decline
themes_detail.summary: Street Light Condition complaints rose to 17 last week, a 134% increase from 7.2 weekly average (z-score: 6.24), reflecting deteriorating public lighting that could affect pedestrian safety and quality of life in Fort Greene/Brooklyn Heights.
evidence: 17 Street Light Condition complaints LAST WEEK vs 7.2 weekly baseline (8-week average)
Z-score of 6.24 indicates statistically significant deviation
Aligns with repeated community board budget request for DOT infrastructure funding
reporting_angles: Contact DOT about street light outages and repair backlogs in CD 302
Map complaint locations to identify neighborhoods experiencing worst lighting failures
Interview residents about safety concerns from inadequate street lighting
